name: Wiki Exfoliating Skin Polish | Natural Glow & Soft Skin Formula
description:
Wiki Exfoliating Skin Polish is a premium skincare solution designed to deliver instant glow and smoothness. Its gentle exfoliating formula removes dirt, dead skin cells, and impurities, revealing fresh and bright skin naturally. Safe for face, hands, and body, it’s enriched with natural fruit extracts, essential oils, aloe vera, and vitamin E for hydration, anti-aging benefits, and deep nourishment. Whether prepping for a party, wedding, or maintaining daily radiance, this polish offers deep cleansing, gentle exfoliation, and long-lasting smoothness. Dermatologist-tested and highly recommended, Wiki Skin Care Polish combines effectiveness with affordability.
Key Features
 Gentle exfoliating formula removes dead skin cells and impurities
 Enriched with fruit extracts, aloe vera, vitamin E & essential oils
 Hydrates, brightens, and nourishes skin naturally
 Safe for face, hands, and body use
 Dermatologist-tested, effective, and affordable
How to Use
 Apply a small amount on damp skin
 Massage gently in circular motions for 3–5 minutes
 Rinse with lukewarm water and moisturize
Material
Natural fruit extracts, aloe vera, vitamin E, essential oils
Safety Information
 For external use only
 Avoid contact with eyes, rinse immediately if contact occurs
 Keep out of reach of children
 Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight
Package Includes
 1 × Wiki Exfoliating Skin Polish
